_doc: The five finales (Dungeon Alive slice 6; src/decor.py dress_boss_floor). Each gate floor wears its domain's theme and is dressed for its showdown from what is really on its map. 'pillars': every free-standing wall column becomes the named prop, drawn on the theme's floor (it stays a WALL tile: still the cover from Medusa's gaze, Fafnir's breath and Fenrir's charge, still a phasing wall for Asterion). 'walls', 'floor', 'stand': props from 'ids' with 'count' [min, max], 'where' boss_room (the room the keeper starts in), any, items (under what earlier visitors left: the Labyrinth's dead ends), dead_ends (floor tiles with one way out), junctions (walls beside a crossing), entry (the arrival room). 'entrance': a decal just inside each way into the boss room. 'hoard': the boss room floor within this many tiles of the keeper is drawn as his hoard bed. 'lore': fixtures here that answer to D (data/lore_fixtures.json, placement 'boss'). 'arrival': a line for a floor that has none. 'barriers': the picture across the stair while its keeper lives, and after (main._descend_stairs keeps the bar itself). 'phase': what the room does when its keeper turns (enrage).

100.arrival: The shaft ends here. Smoke pours up out of the dark as from a great furnace, and in it something vast is moving its wings. Seven black stones stand round the pit, one for every seal you broke.
